#!/bin/bash
# Rebuild the in-kernel `ntfs` (resurrection) module for the RUNNING cachyos
# kernel, with three source fixes, WITHOUT rebuilding the whole kernel:
#   1) MFT/cluster-allocator spurious -ENOSPC (leaves free space unused)   [always]
#   2) statfs: report a roomy free-inode count (MFT grows on demand)       [always]
#   3) windows_names: only enforce invalid-char check with -o windows_names [WITH_WINNAMES=1]
#
# Fixes are applied with sed keyed on unique, stable expressions, so they keep
# working across -rc source drift (they only break if the anchored expression
# itself changes -- which is the signal that upstream touched that code).
#
# Requirements on the build host (all already true here):
#   - clang/lld/llvm-* matching the kernel's LLVM major (kernel: clang 22.x).
#     MODVERSIONS is OFF and MODULE_SIG_FORCE is OFF, so only vermagic must match.
#   - Kernel source tree for fs/ntfs (mainline 7.2-rc; self-contained headers).
#   - The MATCHING -headers package for the RUNNING kernel, which supplies the
#     prepared build tree (Module.symvers, .config, correct utsrelease/vermagic).
#     NOTE: the running kernel is $(uname -r); the headers package MUST match it.
set -eu

KVER=$(uname -r)
SRC=${SRC:-/home/u/Downloads/linux/fs/ntfs}
# headers package: pass HDR_PKG=... or drop the matching *headers*.pkg.tar.zst in ~/Downloads
HDR_PKG=${HDR_PKG:-$(ls -1 /home/u/Downloads/linux-cachyos*headers*.pkg.tar.zst 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)}
PATCHDIR=$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$0")")
WITH_WINNAMES=${WITH_WINNAMES:-0}
export TMPDIR=${TMPDIR:-/tmp}        # keep work off the (inode-tight) NTFS scratch

[ -n "$HDR_PKG" ] && [ -f "$HDR_PKG" ] || {
	echo "ERROR: headers package for $KVER not found."
	echo "  Provide it via HDR_PKG=/path/to/linux-cachyos-rc-headers-<ver>.pkg.tar.zst"
	echo "  (cachyos repo; MUST match the running kernel $KVER)."
	exit 1
}
echo "[*] kernel : $KVER"
echo "[*] headers: $HDR_PKG"
echo "[*] source : $SRC"

WORK=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT

# 1) Extract headers -> prepared build tree
tar --use-compress-program=unzstd -xf "$HDR_PKG" -C "$WORK"
KDIR=$(dirname "$(find "$WORK" -path '*/build/Module.symvers' | head -1)")
[ -n "$KDIR" ] || { echo "build tree not found in headers pkg"; exit 1; }
UTS=$(grep -h UTS_RELEASE "$KDIR"/include/generated/utsrelease.h 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"[^"]*"' | tr -d '"')
[ "$UTS" = "$KVER" ] || echo "WARNING: headers vermagic ($UTS) != running kernel ($KVER); module may not load."

# 2) clang wrapper: cachyos clang injects -fuse-ld=lld, which becomes a fatal
#    error under cc-option's -Werror (breaks CC_USING_FENTRY etc.). Silence it.
mkdir -p "$WORK/bin"
printf '#!/bin/bash\nexec %s -Qunused-arguments "$@"\n' "$(command -v clang)" > "$WORK/bin/clang"
chmod +x "$WORK/bin/clang"
export PATH="$WORK/bin:$PATH"

# 3) Assemble module sources + apply fixes via sed (anchor-checked)
mkdir -p "$WORK/m"
cp "$SRC"/*.c "$SRC"/*.h "$SRC"/Makefile "$WORK/m"/

# fix 1: clamp the bitmap search to the current zone window
sed -i 's#max_empty_bit_range(buf, buf_size >> 3)#max_empty_bit_range(buf, (zone_end > bmp_pos \&\& ((zone_end - bmp_pos) >> 3) < (buf_size >> 3)) ? (int)((zone_end - bmp_pos) >> 3) : (buf_size >> 3))#' "$WORK/m/lcnalloc.c"
grep -q 'zone_end - bmp_pos) >> 3) : (buf_size' "$WORK/m/lcnalloc.c" || { echo "fix1 (mft) anchor missing"; exit 1; }

# fix 2: statfs reports a sane, roomy free-inode count.
#   - clamp f_ffree to [0, f_files]  -> never a negative/garbage "used inodes"
#   - add records that still fit in free space (MFT grows on demand) -> roomy
sed -i '/sfs->f_ffree = atomic64_read(&vol->free_mft_records);/a\
\t{ s64 ff = (s64)sfs->f_ffree, tot = (s64)sfs->f_files, ex = (size << vol->cluster_size_bits) >> vol->mft_record_size_bits; if (ff < 0) ff = 0; if (ff > tot) ff = tot; sfs->f_ffree = ff + ex; sfs->f_files = tot + ex; }' "$WORK/m/super.c"
grep -q 'if (ff < 0) ff = 0; if (ff > tot)' "$WORK/m/super.c" || { echo "fix2 (statfs) anchor missing"; exit 1; }

# fix 3 (optional): gate the invalid-char check behind -o windows_names
if [ "$WITH_WINNAMES" = 1 ]; then
	sed -i 's#if (ntfs_check_bad_char(wc, wc_len))#if (NVolCheckWindowsNames(vol) \&\& ntfs_check_bad_char(wc, wc_len))#' "$WORK/m/namei.c"
	grep -q 'NVolCheckWindowsNames(vol) && ntfs_check_bad_char' "$WORK/m/namei.c" || { echo "fix3 (winnames) anchor missing"; exit 1; }
fi

# 4) Build just the module (BTF disabled -> no pahole dependency; not needed to load)
make -C "$KDIR" M="$WORK/m" LLVM=1 CONFIG_DEBUG_INFO_BTF_MODULES= modules

# 5) Strip + publish next to this script
llvm-strip --strip-debug "$WORK/m/ntfs.ko" -o "$PATCHDIR/ntfs.ko"
echo "[*] built: $PATCHDIR/ntfs.ko"
modinfo "$PATCHDIR/ntfs.ko" 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'vermagic|name:' || true

cat <<'EOF'

Load (unmount all NTFS + detach loops first):
    sudo umount -a -t ntfs ; sudo losetup -D
    sudo rmmod ntfs && sudo insmod ./ntfs.ko
Persist across reboots:
    sudo cp ./ntfs.ko /lib/modules/$(uname -r)/kernel/fs/ntfs/ntfs.ko && sudo depmod -a
EOF
